segments.text: God did not hang that rainbow because Noah was perfect, and the story says so plainly.
He failed again, the way people do. Still, God hung up His own bow.
Before any rainbow, Noah did one thing first on dry ground, and it still stops me every time. Watch what it was.

title: God Did Not Hang That Rainbow Because Noah Was Perfect | Noah, Genesis 8-9 (KJV) #shorts
description:
The Keeper over the waiting of the flood: God remembered Noah, and mercy was never Noah's reward, it was God's idea (Genesis 8-9, King James Version).

Watch the full story, the whole of Genesis 8-9: https://youtu.be/1m-NUJhkdMY
